info.description:
Laptop-local building simulation API for the D7065E lab. Runtime state is in memory and resets when the process stops.
There is no authentication: the server binds to 127.0.0.1 by default and must only be exposed on a trusted network.
Editor endpoints exist only when the server is started with --edit.
info.title: BuildSim API

put.description: Full replacement. Alerts are current operational messages, not a historical log. Viewers are notified with a version counter and re-fetch this snapshot.

get.description: Returns the building name and its ordered list of levels.
Returns the stair and elevator edges that join per-level graphs into one walkable multi-floor graph.
Returns rooms, walls, labels, and both navigation graphs for a single level.
Reports which viewer is active and whether editing endpoints exist, so the browser can adapt without probing.

put.description: Replaces every zone. A zone centres on `room` when given, otherwise on explicit `center` coordinates.
Full replacement. A locked or blocked entry node is removed from walkable routing. Viewers are notified with a version counter and re-fetch this snapshot.

post.description: Available only when the server runs with --edit. Without --edit-output the change affects only the running process; embedded source data is never overwritten.
Available only when the server runs with --edit. The body must be a JSON array.

put.description: Full replacement. BuildSim renders the effect; the simulator owns its evolution. Viewers are notified with a version counter and re-fetch this snapshot.
Full replacement. The browser interpolates between successive positions. Viewers are notified with a version counter and re-fetch this snapshot.

get.description: Returns every equipment item, narrowed by any combination of the filters.

post.description: Registers one equipment item with its sensors and actuators. Bumps the equipment version and notifies viewers.

Creates many items in one request. Items whose ID already exists are skipped rather than rejected, so the call is safe to repeat. Returns 201 when at least one item was created and 200 when every item was skipped.
Bumps the equipment version and notifies viewers without changing state. Normal mutations do this automatically, so this endpoint is rarely needed.

delete.description: Removes the item together with its sensors and actuators.

put.description: Replaces equipment metadata. Omitted sensor and actuator collections are preserved; an explicit empty array removes them.

get.summary: List the actuators of one equipment item
List the sensors of one equipment item

get.description: Returns the room adjacency graph, or the finer walkable graph when type=walkable.

Runs Dijkstra over the selected graph. Give numeric from/to room IDs, or from_name/to_name. Names with type=walkable and no level route across floors, and locked doors are excluded from walkable routes.

parameters.description: Level ID; omit with names and type=walkable to route across floors

put.description: Replaces the whole occupancy map. Keys may be `<level>/<room-name>`, or a bare room name when it is unique across the building.

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 document describing every endpoint below, for use with API clients and code generators.

put.description: Full replacement. Controls room illumination independently of any numeric layer. Viewers are notified with a version counter and re-fetch this snapshot.
Full replacement. A layer is a scalar field keyed by canonical room key. Viewers are notified with a version counter and re-fetch this snapshot.
Publishes a reading. A binary sensor sets binary_value, a text sensor sets value; data_type selects which.

post.description: Allocates a session ID. Connect a WebSocket to /ws/{id} to receive its updates.

put.description: Replaces the coverage overlay for one viewer, leaving the global zones untouched.
Replaces the highlighted rooms for one viewer. Omitted opacity defaults to 0.8.
Replaces the occupancy overlay for one viewer, leaving the global map untouched.
Draws a path in one viewer. Usually the body is a result from /api/graph/route.
put.summary: Show a route in a session

put.description: Moves one viewer: which room is centred, the zoom, and 2D or 3D mode.

get.description: Reports that the process is up. Used by the container health check and by `buildsim health`.

Upgrades to a WebSocket carrying small typed notifications with a version counter. Clients re-fetch the matching REST snapshot rather than trusting the message body. Origins are restricted to the same origin, with a loopback-to-loopback allowance.
